entries.title: Reviews of outside pull requests say a crewmate wrote them
entries.body: When a crewmate reviews someone else's pull request, the story it posts as a comment now opens with a line saying an Infinitary crewmate, an AI agent working for the project's maintainer, wrote it. Each project can turn the line off or write its own in Settings, Projects, Say a crewmate wrote it.

picture.alt: A project's settings with Say a crewmate wrote it switched on and the line it posts
